name: @qu/log
description: Minimal, dependency-free leveled logging: createLogger(scope) plus setLogLevel()/getLogLevel(). Not a full logging framework - just enough structure that every package/app logs through the same scoped, level-filterable channel instead of bare console.* calls, in both Node (a relay's process.env.QU_LOG_LEVEL) and a browser (localStorage's qu:logLevel, controllable live from DevTools).
